# Provenance

Produced by **running the template-version-3 generator**, not written by hand.

    commit    1a83149  ("feat(sqlx): run declared seeds")
    command   renvor new legacy-v3 --database postgres --container --yes
    built in  a detached `git worktree` at that commit, so the working tree was untouched

Template version 3 is the last shape before the Phase 006 container scope addition: it has
`[renvor]`, `[project]`, and `[persistence]`, and **no `[container]` section**. That absence is the
whole point — `renvor check` must keep accepting it after version 4 introduced one.

`Cargo.lock` is excluded. It is regenerated by cargo and is not part of the manifest compatibility
surface; including it would make this fixture churn for reasons unrelated to what it tests.

A hand-written imitation would prove only that the code agrees with the author's recollection of
version 3. If the recollection were wrong in the same direction as the code, both would be wrong
together and the test would pass. See `tests/legacy_compatibility.rs` for the same argument applied
to the Phase 003 fixture.
